analysis.subject: maths
analysis.pageCoverage: Page covers right triangle terminology, angle sum, definitions of sine, cosine and tangent as side ratios, the Pythagorean relationship, ladder examples showing how ratios vary with angle, complementary identities, and use of tables to solve problems.

overview.headline: Right triangle ratios defining sine, cosine and tangent

keyPoints.point: Students learn that sine is the ratio of the opposite side to the hypotenuse in a right triangle.
keyPoints.quote: We will call the ratio of the opposite side of a right triangle to the hypotenuse the sine and give it the symbol sin.

keyPoints.point: Students learn that cosine is the ratio of the adjacent side to the hypotenuse in a right triangle.
keyPoints.quote: The ratio of the adjacent side of a right triangle to the hypotenuse is called the cosine and given the symbol cos.

keyPoints.point: Students learn that tangent is the ratio of the opposite side to the adjacent side in a right triangle.
keyPoints.quote: Finally, the ratio of the opposite side to the adjacent side is called the tangent and given the symbol tan.

keyPoints.point: Students learn that each ratio depends only on the angle value and not on side length.
keyPoints.quote: We claim that the value of each ratio depends only on the value of the angle c formed by the adjacent and the hypotenuse.

keyTerms.gloss: Longest side of a right triangle opposite the right angle
keyTerms.quote: We define the side of the triangle opposite from the right angle to be the hypotenuse.

keyTerms.gloss: Ratio of opposite side to hypotenuse for a given angle
keyTerms.quote: We will call the ratio of the opposite side of a right triangle to the hypotenuse the sine and give it the symbol sin.

keyTerms.gloss: Ratio of adjacent side to hypotenuse for a given angle
keyTerms.quote: The ratio of the adjacent side of a right triangle to the hypotenuse is called the cosine and given the symbol cos.

keyTerms.gloss: Ratio of opposite side to adjacent side for a given angle
keyTerms.quote: Finally, the ratio of the opposite side to the adjacent side is called the tangent and given the symbol tan.

keyTerms.gloss: Sided figure that has a right angle
keyTerms.quote: A right triangle is a three sided figure with one angle equal to 90 degrees.

componentPlan.pedagogicalReason: Helps students explore how opposite and hypotenuse combine to define sine for a right triangle.
Reinforces recall of complementary angle identities and ratio definitions through quick checks.
